notes.subject: Shield Advanced
notes.text: its protections need the account's subscription
how: Before applying, make sure the account subscribes to AWS Shield Advanced (a paid subscription with a one-year commitment): the protections fail without it

notes.subject: Splunk forwarding
notes.text: the forwarders' inputs are rendered (configuration management places them); where they send (outputs.conf, or Splunk Cloud's forwarder credentials package) is the Splunk team's
how: Confirm the servers' Universal Forwarders send to the indexers keeping these indexes

notes.subject: flow log `flow-vpc`
notes.text: kept 30 days, the retention of ops-logs (not set here)
how: Set the retention of ops-logs to 30 days where it is kept

notes.subject: alert rule admin-login-failures
notes.text: not rendered: no alarm in source/stage realizes it (a ciamAlarmBinding with ciamRealizes admin-login-failures): record the one the cloud runs, or let Prometheus evaluate it
